name: Arcadum
title: Ex-guardian of forbidden magic
aliases: Lord of the Twelve Darks, Walker of Gates, Shapeshifter, World Weaver
description: Arcadum was a Twitch streamer, roleplayer, and professional Dungeons & Dragons dungeon master who ran a long-running fantasy campaign called The Living World of Verum. In [VRChat](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/VRChat) he portrayed a demonic mentor character who ran an informal 'school' teaching roleplay etiquette and fairness, mentoring groups such as [The Renegades](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/The_Renegades) and later playing a half-orc barkeep in [Callous Row RP](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Callous_Row_(Archived)). Following controversy and allegations that surfaced in September 2021, his continued presence in the VRChat and Twitch communities became uncertain.
